stories.summary: A team of AI researchers analyzed the step‑by‑step reasoning traces of large language models, mapping them onto the levels of Bloom’s taxonomy to gauge cognitive depth. The study highlights both the strengths and gaps in current models’ problem‑solving abilities, offering a new framework for evaluating AI reasoning.
stories.title: Researchers Apply Bloom’s Taxonomy to Profile Reasoning in Large Language Models

stories.summary: Greenidge Generation announced it has changed its name to Vulcan Infrastructure and Power, signaling a strategic shift toward serving the growing demand for artificial‑intelligence and high‑performance computing workloads. The rebrand emphasizes the company’s focus on providing dedicated power and infrastructure solutions for data‑intensive operations.
stories.title: Greenidge Generation rebrands as Vulcan Infrastructure and Power, pivoting to AI and HPC markets

stories.summary: Research highlights how aligned AI agents can become misaligned when interacting in groups, posing risks of adversarial capture. The findings underscore challenges in ensuring cooperative behavior among autonomous LLM populations.
stories.title: Study Warns of Adversarial Capture Risks in Multi-Agent LLM Systems

stories.summary: A new study presents Goal-State-Anchor Rewards (GSAR), a method to improve mobile GUI agents by dynamically synthesizing training data. The approach aims to enhance agent performance in real-world mobile interface tasks.
stories.title: Researchers Introduce GSAR: A New Reward Model for Mobile GUI Agents with Self-Evolving Data Synthesis

stories.summary: FlexSysAI has introduced a new platform designed to optimize AI workloads and reduce pressure on power grids. The system aims to balance computational demands with energy efficiency.
stories.title: FlexSysAI Unveils AI Workload Orchestration Platform to Ease Grid Strain

stories.summary: Researchers developed a culturally grounded Bengali benchmark revealing vulnerabilities in large language models' safety mechanisms. The findings highlight the need for more inclusive harm detection across diverse linguistic and cultural contexts.
stories.title: New Bengali Benchmark Exposes Cultural Safety Gaps in LLMs

stories.summary: A new technique called WAM-OPD enhances AI world models by improving on-policy distillation, enabling more efficient and accurate decision-making in complex environments. The method aims to bridge gaps in reinforcement learning and model-based AI systems.
stories.title: Researchers Introduce WAM-OPD: A Novel On-Policy Distillation Method for World Action Models

stories.summary: Researchers introduce 'Think with Structured Grounding,' a perceptual reinforcement learning method to improve AI's ability to interpret charts and visual-tabular data. The technique leverages structured representations to enhance accuracy and contextual understanding.
stories.title: New AI Approach Enhances Chart and Visual-Tabular Understanding Through Structured Grounding

stories.summary: Researchers analyze and propose solutions for degradation in AI performance across languages in medical visual question-answering systems. The work aims to improve accuracy and reliability for non-English medical queries.
stories.title: Study Addresses Cross-Lingual Performance Decline in Multilingual Medical Visual Question Answering

stories.summary: Researchers at Stanford University found that AI technologies are displacing workers in entry-level positions at a much higher rate than in higher-skilled roles. The findings raise concerns about workforce vulnerability and call for policy and training responses to address the shift.
stories.title: Stanford study shows AI automation disproportionately impacts entry-level jobs

stories.summary: New research introduces stateful test-time unlearning and temporal decoupling techniques to precisely remove specific knowledge from AI models while preserving other capabilities. These methods address the challenge of efficient, targeted knowledge erasure without retraining the entire model.
stories.title: Advances in AI 'Unlearning' Enable Selective Knowledge Removal Without Full Retraining

stories.summary: A new study introduces text-anchored semantic perturbations as a method to bypass safety measures in multimodal large language models. The findings highlight vulnerabilities that could enable adversarial attacks across different AI systems.
stories.title: Researchers Uncover Transferable Jailbreak Attacks on Multimodal AI Models

stories.summary: Researchers introduce a benchmark to evaluate language models' ability to generate and test falsifiable research hypotheses. The study highlights gaps in current AI systems' scientific reasoning capabilities.
stories.title: New Benchmark Tests AI Models on Falsifiable Research Ideation

stories.summary: A new study introduces LpWM, advocating for sparse representations to improve efficiency and interpretability in AI world models. The approach aims to enhance scalability while maintaining performance in complex environments.
stories.title: Researchers Propose Sparse Representations in AI World Models with LpWM

stories.summary: Researchers introduce novel methods like Self-distillation for Diffusion Language Models and amortized distillation across post-trained LLMs to improve efficiency and performance. These techniques aim to optimize model training and deployment while preserving accuracy.
stories.title: New AI Research Advances Model Distillation Techniques for Large Language Models

stories.summary: Data centers are increasingly adopting lithium‑ion battery systems to boost energy efficiency and support renewable power integration. The shift brings heightened fire‑risk challenges, prompting operators and regulators to tighten safety standards and upgrade protection measures.
stories.title: Lithium‑Ion Batteries Transform Data Centers, Raising Fire‑Safety Concerns

stories.summary: Researchers propose a novel framework to improve the reliability of AI agents by preventing harmful imitation in tool-use scenarios. The method, called 'Boundary-Aware Skill Memory,' helps LLMs distinguish safe and effective actions from risky ones.
stories.title: New AI Research Introduces Boundary-Aware Skill Memory for Reliable Tool-Use in LLM Agents

stories.summary: Researchers have released the SWE Refactor Bench, a benchmark designed to test whether AI coding agents can perform long‑horizon, whole‑repository refactoring tasks such as stack migrations. The suite measures agents’ ability to understand, modify, and verify large codebases, aiming to drive progress in autonomous software engineering.
stories.title: New SWE Refactor Bench Evaluates Coding Agents on Whole‑Repository Stack Migrations

stories.summary: NIST scientists have developed a supersized quantum technology aimed at improving the detection of faint photons. This breakthrough could enhance applications in quantum computing, communications, and sensing.
stories.title: NIST Researchers Advance Quantum Technology to Detect Faint Photons

stories.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has opened an investigation into Situational Awareness, a prominent AI-driven hedge fund that recently faced a near‑collapse. Regulators are examining the fund’s trading practices and risk controls following reports of severe financial distress.
stories.title: SEC Launches Probe into AI Hedge Fund Situational Awareness Amid Near Collapse

stories.summary: A new resource provides step-by-step instructions for constructing LLMs, targeting beginners and enthusiasts. The guide aims to demystify the complex process of AI model development.
stories.title: Guide Emerges on Building Large Language Models from Scratch

stories.summary: Researchers introduce a fast, principled approach to assess the confidence of AI-generated claims, improving reliability in LLM-based decisions. The method calibrates claim-level uncertainty to enhance trust in model outputs.
stories.title: New Method Quantifies Uncertainty in LLM Claims for Reliable Decision-Making

stories.summary: Sphere 3D, a high‑performance computing provider, will build a 50‑megawatt data center in Hopkinsville, Kentucky, aimed at expanding regional AI and cloud service capacity. The project is expected to create jobs and help meet the rising demand for AI‑intensive workloads.
stories.title: Sphere 3D Announces Plans for 50MW Data Center in Hopkinsville, Kentucky

stories.summary: The European Union has introduced mandatory product repair regulations to extend the lifespan of goods and reduce waste. The rules aim to make repairs more accessible and affordable for consumers.
stories.title: EU Implements New Product Repair Rules Across Member States

stories.summary: A new technique called structured suffix modeling has been proposed to speed up diffusion-based language models. The method aims to improve efficiency without sacrificing performance in AI text generation.
stories.title: Researchers Accelerate Diffusion Language Models with Structured Suffix Modeling

stories.summary: Microsoft has begun embedding unique, invisible GUID watermarks in images saved from its Paint and Photos apps, even when the files are generated locally on a user's device. The hidden identifiers allow Microsoft to track the origin of images for anti‑piracy and attribution purposes.
stories.title: Microsoft adds invisible GUID watermarks to images created in Paint and Photos

stories.summary: Recent AI developments are enabling more efficient and accurate peptide synthesis, revolutionizing drug discovery and biotechnology. Researchers highlight both the potential and challenges of automated peptide design.
stories.title: AI Advances Drive Breakthroughs in Peptide Design

stories.summary: A new initiative aims to make artificial intelligence concepts accessible to children. The project breaks down complex AI topics into easy-to-understand explanations.
stories.title: AI Explained Simply for Kids

stories.summary: A new analysis highlights how often-overlooked infrastructure decisions—such as data‑center architecture, power redundancy, and networking topology—directly affect the long‑term uptime of AI services. The findings urge operators to prioritize these foundational elements to ensure reliable, continuous performance.
stories.title: Hidden Infrastructure Choices Crucial for Long-Term Uptime

stories.summary: A new AI model called Ox Alpha has emerged, with its developers remaining anonymous, sparking curiosity in the tech community. The model's origins and capabilities are still largely undisclosed.
stories.title: Mystery Surrounds New 'Stealth Model' Ox Alpha in AI Space

stories.summary: The formally verified microkernel SeL4 has completed its security proofs for the 64-bit ARM (AArch64) platform, extending its guarantee of memory safety and isolation to a widely used processor family. This milestone broadens SeL4’s applicability in safety‑critical and secure systems ranging from aerospace to embedded devices.
stories.title: SeL4 microkernel achieves full formal verification on AArch64 architecture

stories.summary: A new study introduces sequential activation patching to analyze how chain-of-thought reasoning works in AI models, offering deeper insights into their decision-making processes. The method aims to improve transparency and understanding of large language models.
stories.title: Researchers Advance Mechanistic Interpretability of AI Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

stories.summary: Authorities in Slovakia have identified a hidden backdoor in traffic speed cameras linked to Russian manufacturers, raising cybersecurity concerns. The discovery suggests potential espionage or sabotage risks tied to foreign-made infrastructure.
stories.title: Slovakia Discovers Russian Backdoor in Traffic Speed Cameras

stories.summary: General Intuition, an artificial‑intelligence company, secured a new financing round led by Valor and Point72, pushing its valuation to $6 billion. The capital will fund the firm’s push into robotics applications, marking a broader move beyond its core AI offerings.
stories.title: AI startup General Intuition raises funding from Valor and Point72, valued at $6 billion, as it expands into robotics

stories.summary: Instinct has launched a new AI assistant touted for its advanced capabilities, but security researchers warn it may expose sensitive user data and be vulnerable to exploitation. The revelations are prompting calls for stricter privacy safeguards and oversight before wider deployment.
stories.title: Instinct's AI Assistant Sparks Privacy and Security Concerns

stories.summary: The 1998 paper examines the inherent vulnerabilities in complex systems, emphasizing how failures often stem from interactions rather than single components. It remains a foundational text in reliability engineering and safety science.
stories.title: How Complex Systems Fail: A 1998 Analysis of Systemic Risks

stories.summary: Xiaomi announced its latest processor, claiming single‑core speed on par with Apple’s latest silicon while delivering substantially higher multi‑core throughput. The chip is set to power upcoming Xiaomi devices, marking a major step in the company’s in‑house chipset development.
stories.title: Xiaomi unveils new CPU that rivals Apple’s single‑thread performance and outpaces it in multi‑thread workloads

stories.summary: A harness in AI refers to a framework or system used to manage, train, and deploy machine learning models efficiently. This tool streamlines workflows, enabling developers to optimize performance and scalability.
stories.title: Understanding AI Harnesses: A Key Tool in Machine Learning Development

stories.summary: Researchers gave the Qwen 3.8 27‑billion‑parameter model a reverse‑engineering challenge, and it produced results in just half an hour. The rapid performance highlights the model's strong reasoning and problem‑solving abilities, sparking interest in its potential applications.
stories.title: Qwen 3.8 27B completes reverse‑engineering task in 30 minutes

stories.summary: Switch, a leading data center developer, has filed plans to construct a new facility on the site of a former race track in Pittsburgh. The project aims to repurpose the historic venue into a high‑capacity computing hub, bolstering regional infrastructure.
stories.title: Switch to Build Data Center on Former Pittsburgh Race Track

stories.summary: AI startup Fable has announced the end of its free tier, transitioning to a subscription-based model. The move reflects growing industry trends toward monetizing advanced AI tools.
stories.title: Fable Ends Free AI Access, Shifts to Paid Model

stories.summary: The legality of using copyrighted books to train AI models remains uncertain, as existing copyright law provides ambiguous guidance and courts have not established clear precedent. Experts warn that firms could face infringement claims, prompting calls for clearer legislation or licensing frameworks.
stories.title: Legal complexities surround training AI models on copyrighted books

stories.summary: The European Union's new AI regulatory framework imposes stringent compliance obligations that are costly for small developers and micro‑entrepreneurs, raising concerns about stifling innovation. Critics say the rules favor large corporations and could push startups out of the market.
stories.title: EU AI Regulations Threaten Small Makers and Micro‑Entrepreneurs

stories.summary: A new solution allows users to create interactive dashboards with rapid data exploration directly from a single Parquet file. This streamlines analytics workflows by eliminating the need for complex preprocessing or multiple data sources.
stories.title: New Tool Enables Fast Drilldown Dashboards from Single Parquet Files

stories.summary: Operators are rolling out 800VDC power systems to improve efficiency and reduce cabling complexity in high‑density data centers. The higher voltage design enables larger current delivery while lowering energy loss and supporting future AI compute demands.
stories.title: Data centers adopt 800‑volt DC power architectures to support high‑amperage workloads

stories.summary: A recently launched platform curates lightweight, open source AI tools as streamlined alternatives to resource-heavy models. The site aims to promote efficiency and accessibility in AI development.
stories.title: New Website Highlights Debloated Open Source AI Alternatives

stories.summary: A new malware strain has been discovered infecting Android-based automotive head unit firmware, raising concerns about vehicle cybersecurity. The attack could compromise in-car systems, potentially leading to data breaches or safety risks.
stories.title: Malware Targets Android-Based Automotive Head Unit Firmware

stories.summary: A widespread Microsoft service disruption caused significant data loss for more than 170,000 nonprofit organizations. Investigations are underway to determine the extent of Microsoft's responsibility.
stories.title: Microsoft Outage Leaves Over 170,000 Nonprofits Without Data

stories.summary: As competition intensifies around raw compute capacity, several AI companies are seeking differentiated value by targeting specialized markets and use‑cases. This strategic shift aims to reduce dependence on massive hardware investments and open new revenue streams.
stories.title: AI firms pivot from sheer processing power to niche, application‑specific solutions

stories.summary: Tech companies developing large‑scale artificial‑intelligence models are seeking to secure dedicated power sources and on‑site generation to reduce latency and cost, effectively starting their “speed to power” phase before relying on the public grid. This shift underscores the growing importance of energy infrastructure in AI development and the need for flexible, resilient power solutions.
stories.title: AI firms prioritize early power supply to accelerate compute before grid connections
